heroHeadline: Two New FDA Oncology Approvals in One Week: Sonrotoclax — First BCL-2 Inhibitor for Mantle Cell Lymphoma — and Bizengri Expanded to NRG1+ Bile Duct Cancer
heroSubtitle: The FDA approved sonrotoclax (Beqalzi) on May 13 as the first BCL-2 inhibitor specifically approved for relapsed/refractory MCL after BTK inhibitor failure, achieving 52% response rate with 15.8-month durability. Days earlier, Bizengri (zenocutuzumab) received accelerated approval for NRG1 fusion-positive bile duct cancer — extending the NRG1-targeted antibody's reach across three tumor types. Emiltatug ledadotin also received FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for adenoid cystic carcinoma on May 12, one of the first targeted therapy candidates for this rare salivary gland cancer. ASCO 2026 full abstracts drop May 21, with daraxonrasib's Phase 3 pancreatic cancer plenary presentation on May 31.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA Drug Approvals, NIH/NCI, peer-reviewed journals (NEJM, The Lancet, Nature Medicine, JACR), ASCO/ESMO/AACR conference data, and institutional analyses. All clinical data reflect published and presented trial results.
